name: Tag Placement
description: Choose whether a note's frontmatter tags show at the top, at the bottom, or both.
author: Ole Eskild Steensen

settings.name: Tag position
settings.description: Where frontmatter tags are shown on notes. Tags still only show when "Show tags" is enabled.

settings.name: Apply to home page
settings.description: Also use this tag position on the home page. When off, the home page keeps its tags at the top.
